hero_module.enhanced.thor.lightning.desc: Hold to pour lightning from your hand
hero_module.enhanced.thor.thunder.desc: Switch on: hit harder, take less, and your blows arc lightning
hero_module.enhanced.thor.bifrost.desc: Open the rainbow bridge home or to a saved place
hero_module.enhanced.thor.body.desc: More health and armour, hard to knock back
hero_module.enhanced.loki.duplicates.des: Turn invisible while three copies of you lure enemies away
hero_module.enhanced.loki.shapeshift.des: Take the shape of the creature you look at
hero_module.enhanced.loki.vanish.desc: Teleport to where you look, or behind a creature
hero_module.enhanced.loki.frost_giant.de: Jotun form: armour, freezing blows and ice under your feet
hero_module.enhanced.phoenix.mind.desc: Read the mind of whoever you look at
hero_module.enhanced.phoenix.telekinesis: Grab and throw creatures and blocks
hero_module.enhanced.phoenix.control.des: Take over the creature you look at
hero_module.enhanced.phoenix.burst.desc: Hold to charge, let go to send a wave of cosmic fire
hero_module.enhanced.phoenix.body.desc: Fire and lava cannot hurt you
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.power.desc: A violet blast that throws what it hits
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.space.desc: Step through a portal to where you look
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.reality.desc: Turn a creature to stone for a while
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.soul.desc: Hold to drain a creature's life into yours
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.time.desc: Rewind yourself a few seconds back
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.body.desc: Taller and tougher, with long arms and a healing factor
hero_module.enhanced.wanda.chaos_beam.de: Hold: a red beam of chaos magic that burns and dizzies what it hits (the Scarlet Witch's).
hero_module.enhanced.wanda.telekinesis.d: Grab a creature or a loose block in red magic and throw it; with Sneak, tear a block out of the ground or set it down.
Hold: a red dome round you that stops arrows, blows and beams until it wears out.
hero_module.enhanced.wanda.hex.desc: Raise a red dome over the land that only those you let in may cross; press again to control it, Z gives orders to its Vision.
hero_module.enhanced.billy.hex_beam.desc: Hold: crackling blue lightning from your hand, stronger as Billy's rank grows (the Hex Bolt if the server says so).
hero_module.enhanced.billy.telekinesis.d: Grab a creature or a loose block in blue magic and throw it; with Sneak, tear a block out of the ground.
hero_module.enhanced.billy.freeze.desc: Freeze everyone in front of you for a while. Sneak (hold): a blue plate in front of you that stops everything from the front.
hero_module.enhanced.billy.noise.desc: On/off: hear the thoughts of everything around you; they glow through walls in the colour of their mood.
hero_module.enhanced.billy.build_magic.d: The Y key: build, copy and change the world with magic, by Billy's rules (the meter and his rank).
Hold: the Darkhold's purple beam of dark magic. Sneak: mark the creature you look at, or glimpse a mind.
hero_module.enhanced.agatha.drain.desc: Draw the power out of a hero for a while (or the life out of a creature) and heal.
hero_module.enhanced.agatha.shield.desc: Hold: a violet sphere round you that stops blows and turns projectiles to sparks until it shatters.
hero_module.enhanced.agatha.runes.desc: A circle of glowing runes on the ground that binds and burns what stands in it.
hero_module.enhanced.agatha.body.desc: Always: more health, and magic used on you poisons whoever used it.
hero_module.enhanced.magneto.metal.desc: Magneto's grip: lift and throw metal; Sneak with nothing held pulls the metal around you to your hand
hero_module.enhanced.magneto.shrapnel.de: Hold: fire shards of the iron in your pockets
hero_module.enhanced.magneto.disarm.desc: Tear the metal armour and weapons off whoever you look at
hero_module.enhanced.magneto.shield.desc: A switch: arrows and metal shots stop in the air before they reach you
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.time.de: A switch: the world around you slows right down; Sneak puts on Quicksilver's music
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.speed.d: A switch: sprint at Quicksilver's speed and do everything faster; Sneak dashes through enemies
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.blitz.d: Dash to a creature and land six quick hits; Sneak snatches what it holds
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.wall_ru: A switch: at full speed, run up walls, along ceilings and over water (needs Quicksilver's speed or time)
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.barrage: Fling a handful of pebbles at super speed
hero_module.enhanced.vision.mind_beam.de: Hold: a golden beam from your forehead
hero_module.enhanced.vision.phase.desc: A switch: float through walls, floors and attacks like a ghost
hero_module.enhanced.vision.density.desc: A switch: heavy as a building: hard to hurt, hits hard, cannot fly
hero_module.enhanced.vision.disguise.des: A switch: look like an ordinary person
hero_module.enhanced.vision.body.desc: Vision's body: more health and armour, never hungry, never out of breath, made of metal
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.time.desc: A switch: the world around you slows down; you run up walls (Sneak switches that off and on)
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.speed.desc: A switch, on from the start: sprint at Tommy's speed; Sneak dashes through enemies
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.whirlwind.des: Run in circles until everything near spins in the air; Sneak stops dead with a shockwave
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.vibrate.desc: Pass through the wall in front of you; Sneak takes the weapons of everyone around
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.accelerate.de: Shake a block until it breaks, or blast a creature back
hero_module.enhanced.spider.web.desc: Spider-Man's web: wraps the creature you look at in webbing (Sneak: webs everyone around you).
hero_module.enhanced.spider.zip.desc: A web pulls you to the block you look at (Sneak: hold to swing on a web; J switches Web Assist).
hero_module.enhanced.spider.crawl.desc: Stick to walls and ceilings like Spider-Man (Sneak: switch the Spider-Sense that warns of danger). Both start on.
hero_module.enhanced.spider.legs.desc: Four metal legs come out of your back and strike at threats, in any look (Sneak, twice: Instant Kill).
hero_module.enhanced.spider.black_eyes.d: A surge of the spider in you: faster, stronger, sharper senses, then a crash.
hero_module.enhanced.spider.body.desc: Spider-Man's body: quicker, jumps higher, hits harder and lands softly.
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.repulsor.des: Hold to fire plasma bolts from a pool that refills (Sneak: charge one heavy blast).
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.gravity.desc: Yank what you look at to you (Sneak: slam everything near you down).
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.upload.desc: Jump into one of your drones, healed; a drone near you saves you from death (Sneak: hack an enemy Sentry).
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.army.desc: Sentries of your own assemble round you and fight for you (Sneak: send them at what you look at).
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.body.desc: Ultron's machine body: more health and armour, never hungry or out of breath, no poison, no fall damage.
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.sand.des: A wave of sand rolls along the ground the way you face (Sneak: swallow a creature in a cocoon of sand).
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.portal.d: Step through a violet portal to where you look, with your pets and friends.
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.shield.d: Hold for Apocalypse's shield: it stops everything but the power of the mind.
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.bestow.d: Make the ally you look at stronger for a while (Sneak: a storm of sand rises round you).
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.body.des: Apocalypse's body: much more health and armour, hard to knock back, heals when left alone.
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.optic_blast: Hold to fire a red beam of force from your eyes (Sneak: a bolt that bounces off blocks). No glasses needed.
A short, wide blast from your eyes that throws everything in front of you back.
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.leap.desc: Blast the ground to throw yourself up and forward, with no fall damage.
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.rally.desc: "To me!" You and your allies around you get speed, strength and resistance.
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.glasses.des: Sneak: open your eyes wide and a giant beam pours out until you shut them again (press without Sneak).
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.body.desc: Cyclops's trained body: more health and armour.
hero_module.enhanced.xavier.mental_blast: A blow of the mind at whoever you look at: damage that ignores armour, and dizziness.
hero_module.enhanced.xavier.thoughts.des: Hear the thoughts of every mind around you, and see them over their heads.
hero_module.enhanced.xavier.take_over.de: Your mind goes into the creature you look at and steers it; press again to come back.
hero_module.enhanced.xavier.freeze_minds: Everyone with an open mind around you stands still for a few seconds.
hero_module.enhanced.xavier.cerebro.desc: Put on Cerebro's helmet and find the minds of the players far around you.
message.enhanced.cyclops.eyes_open_busy: Your eyes are wide open! Shut them first
message.enhanced.cyclops.eyes_opened: Your eyes open wide! Shut them to stop the beam
item.enhanced.mutant_cure.desc: An injector of the cure. There is no going back
item.enhanced.mutant_cure.desc2: Hold right-click for two seconds to take your power away for good. On another player: an operator, or with PvP on
message.enhanced.mutant_cure.no_power: You have no power to cure
message.enhanced.mutant_cure.not_allowed: Only an operator may cure another player, or anyone while PvP is on
message.enhanced.mutant_cure.disabled: The Mutant Cure does not work on this server
message.enhanced.mutant_cure.too_far: Too far away: the cure did not go in
message.enhanced.mutant_cure.cured: The cure takes hold. You are no longer %s
power.enhanced.heimdall.awaken: The guardian of the Bifrost sees all
power.enhanced.heimdall.broadcast: %s has taken up Hofund and become Heimdall!
ability.enhanced.heimdall.5: Bifrost Strike (Sneak: Bifrost for a friend)
power.enhanced.odin.broadcast: %s sat on the Throne of Asgard and was crowned Odin, the Allfather!
power.enhanced.hela.broadcast: %s put on Hela's headdress and became Hela, the Goddess of Death!
hero_module.enhanced.heimdall.hofund.des: A three-blow golden sword combo (any sword for a custom hero); Sneak: a dash and a thrust.
hero_module.enhanced.heimdall.sight.desc: Creatures glow through walls and far players are marked; Sneak, held: zoom far.
hero_module.enhanced.heimdall.bifrost.de: Opens the Bifrost with no item: home, saved places, Asgard.
hero_module.enhanced.heimdall.ward.desc: Held: a golden dome that stops projectiles and keeps monsters out; Sneak: Einherjar come to your side.
hero_module.enhanced.heimdall.strike.des: A column of rainbow light strikes where you look; Sneak: send the player you look at.
hero_module.enhanced.heimdall.body.desc: More health and armour, steady footing, no damage from short falls.
hero_module.enhanced.odin.gungnir.desc: A golden bolt from the spear (or the hand); Sneak: throw Gungnir, which returns.
hero_module.enhanced.odin.odinforce.desc: Held: a golden dome shield; Sneak: heal yourself and your allies.
hero_module.enhanced.odin.banish.desc: Banishes the creature you look at; Sneak: a golden shock wave.
hero_module.enhanced.odin.ravens.desc: Two ravens circle where you look and show every creature near them.
hero_module.enhanced.odin.command.desc: Warriors fight your target; Sneak: the Odinsleep heals you while you kneel.
hero_module.enhanced.odin.body.desc: More health and armour, steady footing, regeneration when hurt.
hero_module.enhanced.hela.necroswords.de: Throws a fan of black blades; Sneak: blades rain on a circle.
hero_module.enhanced.hela.blade_wall.des: A line of spikes erupts from the ground; Sneak: a ring of spikes round you.
hero_module.enhanced.hela.goddess.desc: The headdress grows: strength and stronger blades; Sneak: a smoke dash.
hero_module.enhanced.hela.army.desc: Berserkers rise to fight for you; Sneak: Fenris the wolf.
hero_module.enhanced.hela.grasp.desc: Held: projectiles crumble before your hand; a thrown Mjolnir is caught.
hero_module.enhanced.hela.body.desc: More health and armour; in Asgard, regeneration and stronger blows.
item.enhanced.hofund.desc: Heimdall's sword: whoever holds it can open the Bifrost
item.enhanced.hela_headdress.desc: Hold it with no power to become Hela

message.enhanced.watch.begins: Heimdall: "%s shadows of Hela hide in the city. See them as I see them, and strike them before %s minutes pass."
message.enhanced.watch.won: Heimdall: "You saw what I see. Hofund is yours now: hold it, and the watch is yours."
message.enhanced.watch.lost: The shadows slipped away. Try again when you are ready.
message.enhanced.watch.fallen: You fell, and the shadows slipped away. Try again when you are ready.
message.enhanced.watch.left: You left Asgard, and the shadows slipped away.
message.enhanced.watch.given_up: You set the Watch down. The shadows slipped away.
message.enhanced.watch.done: You have kept the Watch already.
message.enhanced.watch.rest: Rest first: you may take the Watch again in %s s.
message.enhanced.watch.not_here: The Watch is kept in Asgard.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.watch_running: The shadows are still out there. Look with my eyes, and strike.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.greeting: I saw you coming, from the moment you looked up.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.hold_hofund: Hofund knows your hand now. Hold it, and the watch is yours.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.fellow: Two of us now keep watch over the realms. Where shall the Bifrost take you?
npc.enhanced.heimdall.watch_offer: Seven shadows of Hela hide in the city. See them as I see them, and strike them before the sand runs out.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.watch_rest: The shadows slipped away from you. Rest, and come back to me.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.watch_done: You have kept the watch once. The Bifrost is yours to call.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.idle: I am the guardian of the Bifrost. Where shall it take you?
npc.enhanced.heimdall.lore: I am Heimdall. I see every leaf that falls in the Nine Realms, and I keep the bridge between them.
npc.enhanced.heimdall.hofund_again: A guardian's sword returns to the one it chose. Take it, and do not lose it twice.
npc.enhanced.option.heimdall_back: Take me back where I came from
preset.enhanced.heimdall.desc: Hofund, the all-seeing sight and the Bifrost
message.enhanced.odin.asleep: You sleep the Odinsleep. Press the key of the Odinsleep again to wake.
message.enhanced.odin.sleep_start: The Odinsleep takes you. Rest, Allfather.
message.enhanced.odin.sleep_whole: You wake from the Odinsleep, whole again.
message.enhanced.odin.not_weary: You are not weary: the Odinsleep is for the wounded.
message.enhanced.odin.no_gungnir_in_hand: Gungnir is not in your hand.
message.enhanced.odin.gungnir_crumbles: This Gungnir crumbles to dust: its bond is broken.
message.enhanced.odin.healed: The Odinforce heals you and %s allies.
message.enhanced.odin.banish_nothing: There is nothing there to banish.
message.enhanced.odin.banish_spared: %s is spared: Banish is for foes.
message.enhanced.odin.banish_resisted: %s is too strong to banish, and takes the Odinforce's blow instead.
message.enhanced.odin.banished_you: %s banished you: the Bifrost takes you home.
message.enhanced.odin.command_none: No warrior is near to answer.
message.enhanced.odin.stand_unworthy: Only one who stood against Hela may take Gungnir.
message.enhanced.odin.stand_taken: You take Gungnir from its stand. It answers to you alone.
message.enhanced.odin.stand_returned: Gungnir comes to you again; the one you lost is dust.
message.enhanced.odin.coronation_begins: Golden light pours from the throne. Stay, and hold Gungnir.
message.enhanced.odin.coronation_power: The throne will not crown one who bears another power.
message.enhanced.odin.crowned: You are crowned on the Throne of Asgard. Long may you reign, Allfather.
item.enhanced.gungnir.bifrost: Its owner: use for the Bifrost (Sneak: to where you look)
hud.enhanced.odin.no_gungnir: no Gungnir: press to call it
npc.enhanced.odin.asleep: (Odin sleeps the Odinsleep in a field of golden light. He does not hear you.)
npc.enhanced.odin.hela_heir: I know that darkness; I gave it a name once. Whatever you are, you will not rule here.
npc.enhanced.odin.crowned: A throne is only a chair until someone carries a realm on it. Carry it well.
npc.enhanced.odin.bearer: Gungnir knows your hand now. If you would carry more than a spear, the throne is waiting.
npc.enhanced.odin.victor: You stood against Hela, and I woke. Gungnir waits in the vault beneath this hall. Take it.
npc.enhanced.odin.son: My son. Sit with me a while; the realm can wait a moment.
npc.enhanced.odin.loki: Loki. Whatever you have done this time, tell me plainly.
npc.enhanced.odin.greet: I slept long, and Asgard kept faith with me. Ask, traveller, and I will answer.
npc.enhanced.odin.about_gungnir: Gungnir was forged for the hand that guards the realms. It never misses what it is thrown at, and it always comes home.
npc.enhanced.odin.about_ravens: Huginn is thought, Muninn is memory. They fly where I cannot, and tell me all of it.
npc.enhanced.odin.about_vault: Below this hall. Its door stands open now, for you.
preset.enhanced.odin.desc: Gungnir, the Odinforce and the ravens

message.enhanced.agatha.drain_not_sorcer: Only a witch's or sorcerer's power can be drained: %s's power is no magic
message.enhanced.hero_item.taken_off: %s came off: it is in your inventory
message.enhanced.hero_item.taken_off_dro: %s came off: your inventory is full, it is at your feet
npc.enhanced.common.manners.2: Hey! In Asgard we save our blows for our enemies.
npc.enhanced.common.manners.3: Was that meant to hurt? Try being polite instead.
npc.enhanced.common.busy: One moment, I'm talking with someone else.
npc.enhanced.common.down: Ugh... give me a moment. I'll be back on my feet soon.
npc.enhanced.common.fight_warrior: Hela is here! To the throne room, and fight beside us!
npc.enhanced.common.fight_citizen: Hela has come back! Hide, quickly!
npc.enhanced.common.react_hela: Goddess... please, we mean you no harm.
npc.enhanced.common.react_odin: Allfather! Forgive me, I did not see you come in.
npc.enhanced.common.react_heimdall: Guardian! Who watches the Bifrost while you walk among us?
npc.enhanced.heimdall.manners: I saw that coming before you did.
npc.enhanced.odin.manners: Do you know who I am?
npc.enhanced.frigga.manners: Now, now. Is that how you greet a queen?
npc.enhanced.frigga.greeting_first: Welcome, child of Midgard. You found your way to us; that is no small thing.
npc.enhanced.frigga.greeting.1: The garden is lovely today. Walk with me a while.
npc.enhanced.frigga.greeting.2: You look tired. Asgard can be a lot to take in.
npc.enhanced.frigga.greeting.3: Ask me anything. A queen hears many secrets.
npc.enhanced.frigga.after_hela: You stood against Hela and lived! Asgard owes you. Go down to the vault: Gungnir is waiting.
npc.enhanced.frigga.odin_sleeps: My husband sleeps the Odinsleep. He gave his strength to Asgard, and now he must rest.
npc.enhanced.frigga.odin_awake: The Allfather is awake again. Visit him in the throne room; he likes visitors more than he admits.
npc.enhanced.frigga.odin_asleep: Hush. The Allfather sleeps the Odinsleep. He will wake when Asgard needs him most.
npc.enhanced.frigga.seal: Behind the throne is Hela's Seal. Never break it! She is the Goddess of Death, and her army comes with her.
npc.enhanced.frigga.gungnir: Those who stand against her may one day bear Gungnir, the Allfather's spear. It rests in the vault below.
npc.enhanced.frigga.heal: Let me see that wound. There. The healers of Asgard taught me well.
npc.enhanced.frigga.react_thor: My son! Are you eating properly? You look thin.
npc.enhanced.frigga.react_loki: Loki... be careful, my love. Not every trick ends well.
npc.enhanced.frigga.react_hela: I know who you are. This is still my home.
npc.enhanced.frigga.react_odin: My king. Come, sit with me in the garden.
npc.enhanced.frigga.react_heimdall: Heimdall, old friend. Who watches the Bifrost while you are here?
npc.enhanced.sif.manners: If you want a fight, ask for training. Properly.
npc.enhanced.sif.greeting_first: A new face in the training ring! Can you hold a sword, or do you just carry one?
npc.enhanced.sif.greeting.2: The Warriors Three talk too much. I train.
npc.enhanced.sif.greeting.3: Back again? Good. Practice is how heroes are made.
npc.enhanced.sif.train: Good! First to five touches wins. Wooden-sword rules: nobody gets hurt. Ready?
npc.enhanced.sif.advice: Want to get stronger? Heimdall tests those who would see as he sees. Ask him about his Watch at the Observatory.
npc.enhanced.sif.duel_won: Well fought! You earned this. Keep it, and remember the day you beat Sif.
npc.enhanced.sif.duel_lost: Not bad. Not good either. Come back and try again!
npc.enhanced.sif.duel_draw: Time's up! Nobody wins today. Next time, then.
npc.enhanced.sif.react_thor: Thor! Want to spar? I promise to go easy on you.
npc.enhanced.sif.react_loki: Loki. Keep your tricks away from my hair.
npc.enhanced.sif.react_hela: Stay back! Asgard has warriors, and I am one of them.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.manners: Do that again and you'll be sleeping in the stables.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.greeting_first: Another hero from Midgard? Hm. You look like you can swing a sword. Maybe.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.greeting.1: The horses are fed. What do you need?
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.greeting.2: Make it quick, I have a winged horse to brush. Well, a horse.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.greeting.3: Ready for a fight? No? Then for a ride, at least.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.army: Hela's army are berserkers: old warriors who won't stay down. And she has Fenris, a wolf as big as a house.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.bring_friends: My advice? Bring friends. A lot of friends. And never fight her alone.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.hela: Hela is locked behind a seal in the throne room. If someone breaks it... we all fight.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.horse: Your horse is right here. Treat it well, it bites.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.react_thor: Your Majesty. Don't make me salute.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.react_hela: You. I've fought you before. I'm not running this time.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.manners: Careful! You nearly made me drop my lunch.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.greeting_first: A guest! Sit, sit! You're just in time for second breakfast. Or is it the third?
npc.enhanced.volstagg.greeting.1: Have you eaten? You look like you have not eaten.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.greeting.2: Volstagg the Valiant, at your service! And at the table.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.greeting.3: A warrior fights better on a full belly. That is science.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.greeting.4: Ha! Welcome, friend! Mind the chicken bones.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.joke.1: Why did the frost giant leave the feast? Someone told him to chill!
npc.enhanced.volstagg.joke.2: What's Fandral's favourite food? Anything he can look handsome eating.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.joke.3: Hogun laughed once. It was a Tuesday. We still talk about it.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.joke.4: Why don't trolls play hide and seek? Because they always hide under bridges!
npc.enhanced.volstagg.joke.5: I once ate a whole boar in one sitting. Well, two sittings. The boar was big.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.joke.6: What does a dragon eat for dessert? Knights in shining pastry!
npc.enhanced.volstagg.warriors: We are the Warriors Three! Fandral the Dashing, Hogun the Grim, and me, Volstagg the... Valiant! Yes.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.react_thor: Thor! My friend! Come, the feast is ready!
npc.enhanced.fandral.manners: Careful! This face is the pride of Asgard.
npc.enhanced.fandral.greeting_first: Ah, a new face! Fandral the Dashing, at your service. Lovely day, isn't it?
npc.enhanced.fandral.greeting.1: If I may say so, you wear that armour well.
npc.enhanced.fandral.greeting.2: Have you seen the gardens? Almost as lovely as I am.
npc.enhanced.fandral.greeting.3: A sword is like a dance partner. Treat it kindly.
npc.enhanced.fandral.greeting.4: Lost? Allow me to show you the city.
npc.enhanced.fandral.city: The palace has the tallest spires in the Nine Realms. The gardens are Frigga's; the ring is ours. Don't touch the throne!
npc.enhanced.fandral.bridge: The Rainbow Bridge runs from the city to the Observatory. Only the Bifrost reaches Asgard, and Heimdall sees all who come.
npc.enhanced.fandral.gungnir: Gungnir is the Allfather's spear. They say it waits in the vault for a hero who has faced Hela.
npc.enhanced.fandral.react_thor: Thor! Still not as handsome as me, but close.
npc.enhanced.fandral.react_loki: Loki. Is it really you, or another trick?
npc.enhanced.hogun.vault: The vault lies under the throne room. It stays sealed while the Allfather sleeps.
npc.enhanced.hogun.vault_more: Hela must fall first. Only then will Odin wake and the vault open.
npc.enhanced.hogun.hela: She is Death. Her blades come from the shadows. Watch the floor, not her hands.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.greeting.2: Keep to the roads, and you won't get lost.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.greeting.3: The Einherjar keep Asgard safe. Need help?
npc.enhanced.einherjar.directions: Nearest is the %1$s, %2$s steps %3$s. Past it, the %4$s.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.news.1: They say Heimdall tests those who would carry Hofund. Seven shadows, they say.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.news.2: We guard the seal behind the throne day and night. Nobody breaks it. Nobody.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.news.3: The Allfather sleeps. The queen says he will wake when Asgard needs him.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.news.4: Sif beat ten of us in the ring this morning. Ten!
npc.enhanced.einherjar.news.5: Fall off the edge and Heimdall will catch you. Please do not test it.
npc.enhanced.einherjar.news.6: If Hela ever returns, we fight beside you. That is our oath.
npc.enhanced.citizen.greeting.1: Good day! Lovely weather in the Realm Eternal.
npc.enhanced.citizen.greeting.2: Welcome to Asgard! Have you seen the falls?
npc.enhanced.citizen.greeting.3: Mind the gold, it is polished every morning.
npc.enhanced.citizen.greeting.4: A Midgardian! I have never met one before.
npc.enhanced.citizen.greeting.5: Have you come for the feast? Everyone comes for the feast.
npc.enhanced.citizen.greeting.6: Hello, friend. Asgard is beautiful today.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.1: They say Heimdall can see an ant sneeze in Midgard.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.2: Never touch the seal behind the throne. My grandmother says Hela is sleeping behind it.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.3: The Allfather's spear, Gungnir, is in a vault under the palace. Only a true hero may take it.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.4: Volstagg ate my lunch. And my neighbour's lunch.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.5: In Midgard there are stones that call the Bifrost. You only have to find one.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.6: Hela has a wolf called Fenris. Bigger than a house, they say.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.7: Heimdall gives his sword only to those who finish his Watch. Seven shadows in three minutes!
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.8: Frigga can heal almost anything. Ask her nicely.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.9: The Rainbow Bridge sings when the Bifrost opens. Listen next time.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.10: If Hela returns, they say her army rises from the floor of the throne room.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.11: Sif trains anyone who asks. Win five touches and she gives you her token!
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.12: Valkyrie sells horses at the stables. Bring gold.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.13: The falls go off the edge of the world, into the stars.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.14: When Odin sleeps, the whole palace whispers.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.15: Fandral says he is the most handsome in Asgard. Fandral says many things.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.16: Hogun said three words yesterday. A record!
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.17: Whoever beats Hela will be honoured forever. And maybe crowned, who knows?
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.18: The Einherjar never sleep. Well, they do, but in shifts.
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.19: Gold here is like stone in Midgard. Everything is gold!
npc.enhanced.citizen.rumour.20: Bring friends if you go looking for Hela. Many, many friends.
npc.enhanced.option.heal_me: I'm hurt. Can you help me?
message.enhanced.asgard.protected: The city of Asgard is not yours to change.
message.enhanced.asgard.socket: Hofund rests here. It is Heimdall's to give.
message.enhanced.asgard.rune_fizzle: The runes flicker and go dark. Asgard is closed.
message.enhanced.asgard.rune_resting: The stone is resting. Try again in %s seconds.
hero_module.enhanced.magneto.magnetic_pu: Pull every loose bit of metal around you to your hand, all at once.
Bring your Hex down: the red dome melts away. Needs the Hex.
hero_module.enhanced.wanda.build_magic.d: The Y key: build, copy and change the world with magic, by the Scarlet Witch's rules: no meter, and her Instant switch.
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.walkman: A switch: Quicksilver's music plays while his slowed time is on. Needs Quicksilver Time.
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.dash.de: Dash straight ahead in a silver blur, hitting every enemy in the way.
hero_module.enhanced.quicksilver.pickpoc: Zip to the creature you look at and snatch what it holds.
hero_module.enhanced.billy.hex_barrier.d: Hold: a blue plate of magic in front of you stops everything that comes from the front.
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.wall_run.desc: A switch: run up walls, along ceilings and over water while you run at super speed.
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.dash.desc: Dash straight ahead in a white-green blur, hitting every enemy in the way.
hero_module.enhanced.tommy.sonic_boom.de: Stop dead from top speed: a shockwave throws everything near you back.
In a blink, take the weapons out of the hands of everyone around you.
hero_module.enhanced.loki.dagger_fan.des: Throw a fan of conjured daggers at once.
hero_module.enhanced.thor.shatter.desc: With Mjolnir in hand: it bursts into flying shards that strike around you, then comes together again.
hero_module.enhanced.thor.bifrost_look.d: The rainbow bridge carries you to the place you look at.
Feel every mind around you for a moment, even through walls.
hero_module.enhanced.phoenix.psionic_fie: A burst of mind power pushes and stuns everything around you.
hero_module.enhanced.spider.web_burst.de: Webs fly out all around you and wrap everyone near.
hero_module.enhanced.spider.web_swing.de: Hold to swing on a web from the block above you, let go to fly on (J switches Web Assist).
hero_module.enhanced.spider.sense.desc: A switch, on from the start: a tingle warns you of danger coming.
hero_module.enhanced.spider.instant_kill: Press twice with the spider legs out: they strike with all their force. Needs the legs.
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.titan_slam.d: Punch the ground: a ring of violet force throws everything near you.
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.space_pull.d: A blue portal pulls the creature you look at to you.
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.reality_veil: A switch: a red veil of reality hides you from those around you.
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.soul_sight.d: See every living soul around you glow, even through walls.
hero_module.enhanced.thanos.time_lock.de: Freeze the creatures in front of you in time for a moment.
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.overcharge.d: Charge one heavy plasma blast in your palm, then let it fly.
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.slam.desc: Slam everything near you down into the ground.
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.hack.desc: Hack the enemy Sentry you look at: it fights for you now.
hero_module.enhanced.ultron.command.desc: Send your Sentries at what you look at. Needs the Sentry Army.
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.entomb.d: Swallow the creature you look at in a cocoon of sand.
hero_module.enhanced.apocalypse.sandstor: A storm of sand rises round you and blinds your enemies.
hero_module.enhanced.agatha.hex_mark.des: Mark the creature you look at with a purple rune, or glimpse a mind.
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.ricochet.de: A red bolt from your eyes that bounces off blocks to hit around corners.
hero_module.enhanced.cyclops.open_eyes.d: Open your eyes wide: a giant beam pours out until you shut them. Needs Shut Eyes.

boss.enhanced.hela.title: Hela
boss.enhanced.hela.subtitle: The Goddess of Death returns to Asgard
boss.enhanced.hela.odin_wakes.sub: The Allfather rises from the Odinsleep
boss.enhanced.hela.channel_broken: Her channel is broken! Strike now!
boss.enhanced.hela.channel_healed: The strength of Asgard heals her.
boss.enhanced.hela.line.arrive: So this is the house my father built on my silence.
boss.enhanced.hela.line.army: Rise. The dead of Asgard remember their queen.
boss.enhanced.hela.line.catch: A hammer? I have broken better things.
boss.enhanced.hela.line.defeat: This... is not... the end of me.
power.enhanced.doctor_strange.title: Doctor Strange
power.enhanced.doctor_strange.broadcast: %s opened the Eye of Agamotto and became Doctor Strange!
ability.enhanced.doctor_strange.3: Shield of the Seraphim (hold; Sneak: Seraphim Dome)
ability.enhanced.doctor_strange.4: Crimson Bands of Cyttorak (Sneak: Astral Projection)
power.enhanced.hulk.broadcast: %s stood in the gamma beam and became the Hulk!
hero_module.enhanced.strange.whip.desc: A whip of orange sparks lashes the creature in front and pulls it near; Sneak: it pulls you to a block.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.shields.des: Held: a round mandala shield in front of you; Sneak: a dome of mandalas round you and your friends.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.bands.desc: Red bands bind the creature you look at; Sneak: your spirit steps out of your body.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.portal.desc: A ring of sparks opens a portal here and its twin where you look; Sneak: the Mirror Dimension.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.eye.desc: The Y key, with the Eye of Agamotto: time slows round you; Sneak: turn your own time back.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.body.desc: More health and armour; the cloak catches your falls.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.smash.desc: Both fists into the ground: a ring hurts everyone on the ground; Sneak: grab one and slam it.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.clap.desc: A clap sends a shockwave that throws creatures far; Sneak: a roar that frightens them.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.leap.desc: A giant leap to where you look, landing with a blow; Sneak: a long low bound.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.boulder.desc: Tear up a boulder and hurl it; Sneak: charge shoulder first through everything in your way.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.transform.desc: Turn back into a human and again into the Hulk; the Hulk himself can also switch his two Hulks.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.body.desc: Huge, strong and hard to hurt; rage makes the blows stronger.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.whip_grappl: The Eldritch Whip catches the block you look at and pulls you there.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.seraphim_do: A sphere of mandalas guards you and everyone near you.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.astral.desc: Your spirit leaves the body and passes through walls; press again to return.
hero_module.enhanced.strange.mirror.desc: A bubble where nothing in the real world breaks and your foes cannot leave.
With the Eye of Agamotto: turn your own time back a few seconds.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.grab_smash.des: Grab the creature in front by the legs and slam it left, right, left.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.roar.desc: A roar that frightens and weakens the creatures round you.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.bound.desc: A long low leap forward, again and again.
hero_module.enhanced.hulk.gamma_charge.d: Charge shoulder first and throw aside everything in your path.
hero_module.enhanced.stone.reality.desc: With the Reality Stone: bubbles of false reality; Sneak: turn a thing into another.
hero_module.enhanced.stone.mind.desc: With the Mind Stone: hold for the Mind Beam; Sneak: command the creature you look at.
hero_module.enhanced.stone.time.desc: With the Time Stone (sorcerers only): slow time round you; Sneak: turn your time back.
hero_module.enhanced.stone.power.desc: With the Power Stone: hold for the purple beam; Sneak: a bolt that explodes.
hero_module.enhanced.stone.space.desc: With the Space Stone: step through a portal to where you look; Sneak: choose a world.
hero_module.enhanced.stone.soul.desc: With the Soul Stone: hold to drain a soul; Sneak: see every soul near you.
power_module.enhanced.flight.cloak.desc: A cloak of levitation lifts you: slow and graceful.

npc.enhanced.einherjar.hela_fallen: You beat the Goddess of Death. The guard salutes you.
npc.enhanced.sif.hela_fallen: You stood against Hela and won. Asgard owes you much.
npc.enhanced.valkyrie.hela_fallen: Hela fell before you. I did not think I would live to see that.
npc.enhanced.volstagg.hela_fallen: A toast to the one who beat Hela!
npc.enhanced.fandral.hela_fallen: They will sing songs about you. Almost as many as about me.

npc.enhanced.frigga.odin_player: The Allfather has woken: %s sits the throne now. Be kind to them; a crown is heavier than it looks.
npc.enhanced.hogun.vault_player: The vault lies under the throne room. The Allfather has woken: %s holds its key now.
npc.enhanced.hogun.vault_more_player: Odin has woken. %s carries his name now. Ask them, not me.

npc.enhanced.agatha.greeting.1: Back again? Good. The soup is on and the kettle is singing.
npc.enhanced.agatha.greeting.2: Hello, dear. Shoes off, magic on.
npc.enhanced.agatha.greeting.3: Welcome back. Nicky has been asking about you. Twice. Loudly.
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_billy: Teen! Still causing chaos? Good. Wipe your feet anyway.
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_wanda: Wanda. Let's keep it neighbourly this time. Tea?
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_tommy: Slow down, speedy! You'll scuff my floor. Sit. Eat something.
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_wolverine: Claws off the furniture, please. And no growling at the rabbit.
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_deadpool: You're not getting the recipe. Stop asking. Yes, I can see you thinking it.
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_strange: Doctor. Lovely cape. Keep it away from the candles.
npc.enhanced.agatha.hero_hulk: Duck under the door frame, dear. And mind the lanterns.
npc.enhanced.agatha.scratchy_gone: Señor Scratchy is gone again. Would you find him? He likes carrots.
npc.enhanced.agatha.scratchy_thanks: Bless you. Look for a little green glow. Bring him close to his hutch and he'll hop right in.
npc.enhanced.agatha.scratchy_looking: Any sign of Señor Scratchy? Hold a carrot and he'll follow you anywhere.
npc.enhanced.agatha.scratchy_reward: You found him! Thank you. Here: for your trouble, and a little luck.
npc.enhanced.agatha.family: Nicky is my whole heart. Rio is family too. It took a long road to get here, and now we eat dinner together every night.
npc.enhanced.agatha.nicky: My son. He wants to fly a broom. I told him: when you're taller than the broom.
npc.enhanced.agatha.rio: Rio keeps the garden. We used to argue about everything. Now we argue about tomatoes.
npc.enhanced.agatha.road: The door in the cellar opens onto the Witches' Road. Only witches walk it... or those who seek it with the right gene.
npc.enhanced.agatha.road_closed: The cellar door is asleep for now. Even the Road needs a rest.
npc.enhanced.agatha.asleep: Zzz... five more minutes... the soup can wait...
npc.enhanced.nicky.greeting_first: Hi! I'm Nicky. Do you want to see my broom? It doesn't fly. Yet.
npc.enhanced.nicky.greeting.1: Hi! Did you bring snacks? Mom says I'm not allowed to ask. I'm asking.
npc.enhanced.nicky.greeting.2: You're back! Want to race? I'm really fast. Faster than Scratchy. Sometimes.
npc.enhanced.nicky.greeting.3: Hello! I'm practising magic. So far I can make cookies disappear.
npc.enhanced.nicky.greeting_mom: Mom! Can we have the magic soup tonight? The one with no carrots?
npc.enhanced.nicky.hero_wolverine: Whoa, real claws! Can you open a jar of pickles with those?
npc.enhanced.nicky.hero_deadpool: Your mask is so cool. Can I try it on? Mom says no.
npc.enhanced.nicky.hero_hulk: You're SO big! Can I have a ride on your shoulders? Please?
npc.enhanced.nicky.hero_billy: Billy! Teach me a spell! A small one! Please?
npc.enhanced.nicky.play: Do you want to see my broom? It doesn't fly. Yet. I'm working on it.
npc.enhanced.nicky.mom: In the kitchen, making soup. She says it's magic. It's mostly carrots.
npc.enhanced.nicky.mom_player: Mom? She's %s now! She's out on the Road, but she always comes home for dinner.
npc.enhanced.nicky.mom_you: Mom, that's you! Did you forget? Too much magic again.
npc.enhanced.nicky.gift: I made you something! Don't lose it, okay?
npc.enhanced.nicky.gift_done: I only make one present a day. The rest are for Mom.
npc.enhanced.nicky.rio: Rio taught me which mushrooms are for eating and which are just for looking at.
npc.enhanced.nicky.scratchy: Señor Scratchy is the best rabbit in the whole woods. He hates baths.
npc.enhanced.nicky.scratchy_gone: Scratchy ran away AGAIN. Mom says he's 'exploring'. Can you find him? He loves carrots!
npc.enhanced.nicky.scratchy_found: Scratchy! You found him! You're the best!

npc.enhanced.rio.greeting.1: Welcome back. The bees aren't home, but the flowers are.
npc.enhanced.rio.greeting.2: Ah, you again. Good. Sit a while; the garden likes company.
npc.enhanced.rio.greeting.3: Hello, love. Everything is growing nicely today.
npc.enhanced.rio.greeting_agatha: There you are. The soup is still warm.
npc.enhanced.rio.chat: What would you like to know?

npc.enhanced.rio.agatha: Agatha? In the kitchen, arguing with a soup. The soup usually wins.

hero_module.enhanced.iron_man.missiles.d: Tiny missiles that chase foes and pop; Sneak: drones that fire lasers for you.
hero_module.enhanced.iron_man.suit.desc: Armour all over and a suit energy meter that powers your moves.

book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.author: A traveller
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page1: Eternity is all of time and space, seated at the heart of the universe. One who reaches him may ask for one wish.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page2: Infinity is the endless space between the stars, Eternity's sister.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page3: Death is a kind and patient traveller who walks with everyone at the end of the road.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page4: The Living Tribunal has three faces and judges fairly over all the worlds.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page5: Galactus is the giant who travels between the stars, always hungry for worlds.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page6: Arishem is the first of the Celestials, the giants who build the universe.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page7: Oblivion is the quiet nothing that was before everything.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page8: Master Order and Lord Chaos stand across from each other forever: neat lines against wild shapes.
book.enhanced.cosmic_entities.page9: To speak with Eternity, bring a key of the Bifrost to his altar.
